description: `serve.json: {"trailingSlash": false, "cleanUrls": false}` → paths ending in `/` get a 301 to the stripped form. `cleanUrls` is explicitly disabled so the cleanUrls 301 (Stage 6c) cannot mask or compose with the trailingSlash redirect. The anti-redirect anchor uses `/about.html` (no trailing slash, file with extension served directly) to verify phase 5 does not fire when it should not. Backs SRV-ROUT-004.
